scope: tick 1 of overnight 2026-09-26, read complete: the 9 senses of annotated-019r (the two stale-axis families re-authored from scratch) and the 4 superlative-collision repairs in data/policy/carried-001/repairs.json

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Concedes only that sin is possible, not that any has been done, where *sinful* finds the wrong already there.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: States only that reform will not take, a practical verdict without *irredeemable*'s sense of a soul past saving.

entries.definition: a preset plan of action in team sports
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A plan set in advance that a sports team runs during a game, far narrower than a *scheme*.

entries.definition: a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A plan a person or group has chosen and taken on as their own; the stress is on that choice.
examples: it was a policy of retribution

entries.definition: an elaborate and systematic plan of action
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Stresses size and order: a plan with many worked-out parts, more elaborate than a plain *plan*.
examples: A scheme of which every part promises delight can never be successful
It would be such a delicious scheme, and I dare say would hardly cost anything at all.

entries.definition: a procedure or process for obtaining an objective
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Puts the weight on method: the steps or process you follow to reach a goal.
examples: they had to devise a system that did not depend on cooperation

entries.definition: a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Holds the idea as something sensed inside, with no grounds offered, where *impression* at least implies something was noticed.
examples: I had a feeling that she was lying
I have a feeling that it will rain before evening.
She had a feeling the shop would be shut.

entries.definition: a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names the idea as something taken in rather than worked out, without *opinion*'s readiness to stand behind it.
examples: his impression of her was favorable
I had an impression that the two of them had met before, though neither of them said so.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Stately and formal, it gives a refined woman more weight and dignity than *lady* does.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: It spells out the gentle manners that *lady* only suggests, in a more formal voice.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest word for a woman of grace and good manners, and warmer than *gentlewoman*.
examples: a chauffeur opened the door of the limousine for the grand lady
She behaved like a lady at every moment of the visit.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A shortened *madam*: the same respect for a refined woman, said more softly and briefly.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and respectful, it names a refined woman while keeping more distance than *lady*.
